name: title
label: Title
help_text: Mantener como Heading 2. El texto en negrita (strong) se muestra con el acento de color/gradiente.

name: items
label: Items
help_text: Cards en grid de 2 columnas (1 columna en mobile). El número de cada card (01, 02…) se genera automáticamente según el orden.

children.name: title
children.label: Item title
children.help_text: Texto en negrita de la card (no es un encabezado).

children.name: badge
children.label: Badge
children.help_text: Opcional. Pill junto al número (ej. "Additional Cost"). Déjalo vacío para ocultarlo.

default.title: New Venue. More Time Together.
default.description: Sessions and evening activities are all on-site at the Hilton Toronto Suites Conference Centre. Less travel means more time with Compugen teams and more chances to pick up a conversation where you left off.

default.title: Innovation Lounge: Show What’s Possible
default.description: The Innovation Lounge is back. Demonstrate your solutions, show sellers exactly where they fit, and build the relationships that lead to joint wins. Early access lets you set up ahead of the evening so your time on sales and strategy.

default.title: Partner Vision Session: What’s Next for Compugen
default.description: Get a first look at Compugen’s priorities and where we see opportunity. This dedicated panel of leadership insights helps you align your plans with ours, so we can grow faster, together.

default.title: Stay Where It’s Happening
default.description: A block of discounted rooms is reserved for partners at the Hilton Toronto Suites Conference Centre, steps from every session and the evening event. Accommodation is an additional cost, paid directly by partners.

name: anchor_id
label: Anchor ID
help_text: Opcional. ID de la sección para enlazar desde un CTA (sin #). Déjalo vacío si no hace falta.

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en desktop. Izquierda/derecha ocultos: el espaciado horizontal lo da .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Padding superior/inferior en mobile (max-width: 767px), independiente del valor de desktop.
